violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CHANGING GLOVES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS AFTER HANDLING RAW BEEF PATTIES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEE TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED HAND WASH SINK AT END OF GRILL LINE UNABLE TO DISPENSE WATER FOR HAND WASHING AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INDICATED WORK ORDER WAS PLACED ON 01/16/2026 AND WAS SCHEDULED FOR REPAIR 01/21/2026. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE REPAIR HAS BEEN COMPLETED.
